statements.impact_statement: CVE-2022-0563 is in the chfn and chsh programs of util-linux when they are built with readline support: an unprivileged user can set INPUTRC to make them print parts of a root-owned file (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2022-0563, https://bugzilla.redhat.com/show_bug.cgi?id=2053151). We checked the file lists of every binary package of every published util-linux build in the DHI Debian repository, including the debug-symbol packages and the older bsdutils and login rebuilds that are still published, for amd64 and arm64. None contains chfn or chsh; Debian builds util-linux with --disable-chfn-chsh and ships those programs from the shadow source instead.
